connector.name: Legal Text MCP De
connector.registryDescription: German federal & state legal texts (BGB, DSGVO, ...) with canonical IDs and cite-grade provenance.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package legal-text-mcp-de. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the klein-business account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DATASET_PATH
env.description: Path to a normalised corpus directory or a corpus archive (legal-texts-de-*.tar.zst). Defaults to the bundled fixture; production deployments should mount /data/corpus/latest.tar.zst.

env.name: STRICT_DATASET
env.description: Set to 'true' to refuse to start if the dataset cannot be loaded (recommended for hosted deployments).

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Required only for the smart `research_topic` tool which uses LLM-assisted synthesis. Without it, the tool degrades gracefully to a ranked-search fallback.
